description_en: Changes the switchover time of O\&M events
description_zh: 调用ModifyMaintenanceAction接口修改运维事件的执行时间
kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-maintenance-action --resource-group-id rg-4690g37929XXXX --ids 11111 --switch-time 2021-07-09T22:00:00Z --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyMaintenanceAction

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the pending O\&M event. You can specify multiple IDs to batch change the switchover time. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).
> - You can call the [DescribeMaintenanceAction](~~271738~~) operation to query the information about pending O\&M events, including the event ID.
> - You can change the switchover time only for pending O\&M events. The switchover time of historical O\&M events cannot be changed. For more information about the status of pending and historical O\&M events, see [DescribeMaintenanceAction](~~271738~~).
parameters.description_zh:
目标待处理运维事件的ID。支持输入多个ID来批量修改切换时间，多个ID间用英文逗号（,）隔开。

> * 您可以调用[DescribeMaintenanceAction](~~271738~~)接口查看目标待处理运维事件的详情，包括ID。
> * 仅待处理运维事件支持修改切换时间，历史运维事件不支持修改切换时间。关于待处理运维事件和历史运维事件的状态详情，请参见[DescribeMaintenanceAction](~~271738~~)。

> - You can change the switchover time only for pending O\&M events. The switchover time of historical O\&M events cannot be changed. For more information about the status of pending and historical O\&M events, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/271738.html

parameters.description_en: The point in time when you want the system to perform operations on the pending O\&M event. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC.
parameters.description_zh: 后台将在指定时间点执行目标待处理运维事件所对应的操作。格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）。

The ID of the region where the pending O\&M event occurs.

> - You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~143074~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
